name: Tang Ancestral Hall (Ha Tsuen)
scope: Tang Ancestral Hall in Ha Tsuen, with its three-bay entry, rear halls, two interior yards and courtyard side chambers.
era: The standing monument completed in 1750, with the restored roof and unpainted stone and brick finishes documented by the Antiquities and Monuments Office.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla original showing the portal, three front bays, drum platforms, broad tile roof and ornamental ends before the documented restoration of surface finishes.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The exact Qualla file matches Chong Fat’s Commons upload. Wikimedia’s unified account record links the original Chinese Wikipedia creator and the Commons uploader. The official restoration record controls surface treatment where it changed after the photograph.
